info.name: Global Booking — Auth, Business and Booking API
info.description:
Postman v2.1 collection for the Global Booking auth-service and business-service.

AuthResponse is { tokens, user }. Access and refresh tokens are captured automatically. All business-domain requests inherit the collection Bearer token. The business CRUD flow is chained: Business → Establishment → BookingService/Resource.

Recommended runner order: Register → Login → Auth checks → Business CRUD → Logout.

request.description: Checks the current capacity and optional weekly operating schedule before creation.

exec: const start = new Date(Date.now() + 60 * 60 * 1000); start.setSeconds(0, 0); const end = new Date(start.getTime() + Number(pm.environment.get('bookingDurationMinutes') || 60) * 60 * 1000); pm.collectionVariables.set('bookingStartAt', start.toISOString()); pm.collectionVariables.set('bookingEndAt', end.toISOString());
pm.test('Response time is within the configured limit', () => pm.expect(pm.response.responseTime).to.be.below(Number(pm.environment.get('maxResponseTimeMs') || 3000)));

const b=pm.response.json(); pm.test('Availability response shape is valid', () => { pm.expect(b.startAt).to.be.a('string'); pm.expect(b.endAt).to.be.a('string'); pm.expect(b.available).to.be.a('boolean'); });
